sources: Sportmonks ball-by-ball, IPL 2024-2026 (data/ipl), super overs excluded; economy = runs conceded per over (byes and leg byes included)

long.vo: For seventeen seasons, Royal Challengers Bengaluru had the stars and no trophy. Then they won in twenty twenty-five. And again in twenty twenty-six. Everyone credits the batting. The data says something else.

Start with the bowling. In twenty twenty-four, RCB had the seventh-best economy of ten teams, at nearly ten an over. In twenty twenty-five, they jumped to second. And in twenty twenty-six, second again.

head.sub: RCB ECONOMY · RANK OUT OF 10 TEAMS

long.vo: The biggest change came in the powerplay. In twenty twenty-four, RCB leaked more runs in the first six overs than the league average. In twenty twenty-five, they had the best powerplay bowling in the IPL, almost a full run an over better than average.

head.sub: POWERPLAY ECONOMY, RCB BOWLING VS LEAGUE

long.vo: Who did it? In twenty twenty-five, Josh Hazlewood took twenty-two wickets and Krunal Pandya went at just over eight an over. And in twenty twenty-six, Bhuvneshwar Kumar took twenty-eight wickets at seven point nine five, the best economy of any of the top five wicket-takers.

The batting didn't need to be spectacular. It needed to be reliable. विराट कोहली made six fifty-seven in twenty twenty-five, and six seventy-five in twenty twenty-six, at a strike rate near one sixty-six.

And in the twenty twenty-six final, it all came together. The bowlers held Gujarat to one fifty-five for eight. कोहली finished it with seventy-five not out off forty-two balls, with two overs to spare.
Our verdict? RCB's titles were built by the bowlers. The batting just had to finish the job.
Can RCB make it three in a row? Tell us in the comments, and subscribe for more data stories.

short.vo: Everyone says RCB won back-to-back titles with batting. The data says bowling.
In twenty twenty-four, their bowling ranked seventh of ten. In twenty twenty-five and twenty twenty-six, second.
In twenty twenty-five, they had the best powerplay bowling in the league.
And in twenty twenty-six, Bhuvneshwar Kumar took twenty-eight wickets.
Can RCB make it three? Full breakdown on the channel.
